research_question: Do regularized coaxial vortex-ring rank swaps and smooth independent meridional/azimuthal finite-width Euler initial fields yield convergent dynamics; is a new nonimposed spinorial two-turn response demonstrated?
objective: Separate classical geometric ring overtakings and numerical backend parity from true discrete energy levels, finite-core Euler carrier dynamics, and genuine spin-1/2 representation. v0.1.2 adds dense trace, Hermite root/event convergence, clearance, a periodic 3D Euler research pilot and independent numerical G5/G10 gates. v0.1.2 repairs G10 evaluation order only; no numerical physics kernel, target or threshold is modified.
null_hypothesis: Continuous classical ring-overlap-free trajectories, sign-dependent velocity and smooth Galerkin Euler evolution do not in themselves produce quantized intrinsic energies, electron identity, or projective spinor holonomy.
alternative_hypothesis: An independently certified continuum finite-core Euler model exhibits discrete, parameter-robust intrinsic eigenclasses and uniquely derived spinorial 2pi/4pi holonomy without imposed state phase. This hypothesis is NOT evaluated in v0.1.2.
assumptions: No external forcing and incompressible inviscid homogeneous medium; absolute evolution time t.
Filament-proxy core-volume a_i^2 R_i is imposed and cannot certify finite-core Euler.
Ring axis constrained to circular shape; no reconnection or contact allowed for physical interpretation.
A separate periodic dealiased 3D Euler Galerkin pilot uses smooth finite-width initial velocity fields and Fourier Leray projection.
Independent meridional/azimuthal initial velocity amplitudes are not separately conserved circulation quanta.
Classical ordinary vector velocity has 2pi-return; sign-changing spinor phase needs independently derived bundle.
Preregistered reference R0, Gamma0, t0 are conditional SST unit scales only.
